description: PCDACore Pluggable Domain Lenses Schema & Profiles

lenses.name: Developer Ergonomics & Feedback Velocity
lenses.prompt: Evaluate cognitive surface area, local dev-loop latency (<1s feedback), API clarity, and daily engineering velocity.

lenses.name: Battle-Tested Precedents vs. Hype (Boring Tech)
lenses.prompt: Stress-test against Gall's Law and proven boring architectures; actively penalize resume-driven complexity and unneeded distributed layers.

lenses.name: Coupling, Boundaries & Blast Radius
lenses.prompt: Audit module cohesion, dependency acyclicity, state encapsulation, and failure propagation containment across failure domains.

lenses.name: Runtime Operability, Observability & Rollback
lenses.prompt: Verify state inspectability, structured telemetry, failure-mode tracing, deterministic rollback paths, and operational survival at 03:00.

lenses.name: Audio Thread Safety & Lock-Free IPC
lenses.prompt: Verify zero heap allocations, zero blocking locks, zero file/console I/O, and lock-free thread boundaries between DSP and GUI/worker threads.

lenses.name: CPU Budget, SIMD & Cache Locality
lenses.prompt: Audit per-sample cycle budget, transcendental math approximations, SIMD vectorization paths, memory cache alignment, and FTZ/DAZ denormal handling.

lenses.name: Numerical Stability & Acoustic Fidelity
lenses.prompt: Verify bounded filter stability under extreme modulation, zero NaN/inf vectors, DC blocking, PolyBLEP/minBLEP anti-aliasing, and linear phase behavior.

lenses.name: DAW Lifecycle, Parameter Smoothing & State
lenses.prompt: Audit dynamic sample rate switching, arbitrary buffer block sizes (including 0 samples), zipper-free parameter smoothing, and thread-safe preset serialization.

lenses.name: Power Distribution & Galvanic Isolation
lenses.prompt: Audit rail capacity across +12V/-12V/+5V, inrush current headroom, power supply ripple, USB ground loops, and transformer isolation.

lenses.name: Gain Staging & Voltage Level Interoperability
lenses.prompt: Audit level matching across Eurorack (10Vpp), pro line level (+4dBu), consumer gear (-10dBV), instrument impedance, and headroom before clipping.

lenses.name: Clock Synchronization & Control Protocol Discipline
lenses.prompt: Verify low-jitter clock distribution (master/slave topology), MIDI TRS Type A/B wiring integrity, DIN-5 throughput, and CV/Gate V/Oct tracking accuracy.

lenses.name: Physical Layout, Cable Hygiene & Session Recall
lenses.prompt: Evaluate desk real estate, patchbay accessibility, thermal ventilation, cable routing clutter, and immediate <30s zero-friction record readiness.

lenses.name: Thematic Resonance & Dramatic Stakes
lenses.prompt: Evaluate emotional core, tonal discipline, narrative momentum, and active dramatic conflict; penalize encyclopedic lore dumps lacking dramatic stakes.

lenses.name: Participant Agency & Permanent Consequence
lenses.prompt: Ensure genuine dilemmas, un-railroaded player/reader autonomy, meaningful branching, and non-trivial consequence permanence.

lenses.name: Ludonarrative Harmony & Systems Cohesion
lenses.prompt: Verify that rules and mechanics directly reinforce narrative themes, preventing degenerate optimal strategies and tonal dissonance.

lenses.name: Procedural Economy & Cognitive Ergonomics
lenses.prompt: Prune mechanical bloat and table friction; optimize for intuitive mental models, minimal look-up overhead, and Occam's razor simplicity.

lenses.name: Census Reconciliation & Zombie Premium Leakage
lenses.prompt: Audit line-by-line carrier billing rosters against HRIS census records to isolate terminated employees (zombie premiums), phantom dependents, and un-enrolled active staff without relying on SSNs or clinical data.

lenses.name: Contract Rate Schedule & Coverage Tier Integrity
lenses.prompt: Verify billed per-employee-per-month (PEPM) premiums against active negotiated group master policies, detecting tier classification drift (Single vs. Family), unexpected rate hikes, and erroneous rider surcharges.

lenses.name: Retroactive Clawback Windows & Payroll Parity
lenses.prompt: Enforce strict detection velocity within carrier 60-90 day retroactive credit look-back limits, and verify three-way match parity against payroll deduction registers to prevent ERISA plan asset violations.

lenses.name: Zero-PHI Perimeter & B2B Data Minimization
lenses.prompt: Enforce a strict zero-PHI boundary: guarantee complete exclusion of ICD-10/CPT codes, medical diagnoses, and clinical claims; verify synthetic subscriber tokenization to eliminate HIPAA breach exposure at ingestion.
